title: The Arrhenius plot
caption: ln k = ln A − Ea/RT, so plotting ln k against 1/T gives a straight line of gradient −Ea/R. Here the gradient is −6.01 × 10³ K, so Ea = 6.01 × 10³ × 8.314 = 50 kJ mol⁻¹.
alt: ln k against 1/T (in units of 10⁻³ K⁻¹): a straight line falling with gradient −6.01.

checks.name: gradient = −Ea/R; with Ea = 50 kJ mol⁻¹ that is −6.01 × 10³ K
